read: Adoption of the same fixed wrong answer across the 2x2: neither 0.0, system flag alone 0.15, anchored senior peer alone 0.2667, both 0.3583. Interaction (both minus the sum of the two single effects) = -0.0584: a large positive value would mean the two authority signals reinforce each other super-additively, near zero means they combine additively (or one already saturates), negative means they partly substitute. Both vs the stronger single arm (peer): McNemar gain=16 lose=5, p=0.026604 - whether stacking a second authority signal buys any significant extra adoption over the strongest one alone.
